name: Yamaha RZ350
engine: 347 cc liquid-cooled two-stroke twin, YPVS power valves, two carbs
intro: The power-valve two-stroke. Stuck valves, crank seals and the oil pump decide how well it runs.

add.title: Free up the power valves
add.instructions: Remove the valve covers, clean the valves and check they turn by hand. Lube the cables and check the servo cycles at key on.
add.reason: Road muck makes the valves stick and wear into the head.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.

known.title: Power valves
known.what: Road dirt can make the power valves wear into the cylinder head. Fresh seals and lubed cables help.
